method.speaking_time: speaker_turn intervals clipped to each subtopic boundary; each turn contributes only its intersecting duration
method.turn_count: number of source speaker_turn intervals intersecting each subtopic; a turn crossing a boundary is counted once in each intersected subtopic
method.speech_share: speaker clipped turn-duration sum divided by total clipped speaker-turn duration within the same subtopic, multiplied by 100
method.dominant_speaker: speaker with the greatest clipped speaker-turn duration in the subtopic
method.topic_coverage: subtopics with positive clipped speaking time
method.consistency: uses the same speaker_turn duration basis as final_result_numeric.json
method.overlap_note: speaker turns may overlap; if they do, their durations are counted for each speaker, matching speaker-wise duration accounting in the existing pipeline
